summary: Backend + frontend testing of the terrain (public-token) extension on /suivi. 20/20 pytest cases pass (9 new terrain + 11 regression). Frontend terrain page (/suivi/terrain/{token}) verified via Playwright: all testids visible (allee-card, allee-input-rails_es, allee-geo-rails_es, allee-geo-warn, allee-geo-explain, allee-geo-comment, allee-add-photo, allee-validate, allee-block, night-report-2), photo upload via hidden file input works (photo-del appears), invalid token shows terrain-error. Chef dashboard (/suivi, admin): terrain-link-card + terrain-toggle work, terrain-link + terrain-copy shown when enabled with correct URL, alert-geoloc-0 present and clickable → navigates to Nuits tab (suivi-nuits visible).

issues: When a photo is uploaded, thumbnail sometimes renders as an empty green square while the image loads/fails silently for tiny 1x1 test PNGs. GET /photo/{id} returns 200 and correct bytes; likely an aspect-ratio / rendering edge case for very small images and does not affect real usage.

critical_code_review_comments: suivi_deploy.py::_build_state builds a full state dict for every terrain PATCH via subsequent GET; acceptable but the geoloc alert message uses '⚠ Explication demandée' — good, matches spec. The 'terrain' key is correctly hidden when is_terrain=True (verified).
Terrain endpoints skip auth entirely (by design). Rate-limiting the public token endpoints (photo upload especially) should be considered before production.
MAX_PHOTO_BYTES=8MB enforced server-side ✓ but the token URL is a bearer secret in path — logs may contain it. Consider using a header or query redaction in access logs.
AlleeUpdate has ge=0 on all *_reel and *_geo fields — negative rejected with 422 ✓ (verified).
